0022600022.text: The LA Clippers (1-2, 4th in the Pacific and 12th in the West) are on a two-game losing streak and have yet to win on the road, while the Minnesota Timberwolves (3-2, 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West) are also on a two-game skid after a 3-2 start. Out for the Clippers are Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Jordan Miller, Max Strus, Rui Hachimura and Yanic Konan Niederhauser, and Minnesota will be without Anthony Edwards and Donte DiVincenzo. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the Clippers winning the most recent meeting 153-128 in Los Angeles on March 11, 2026.
